metadata.title: नक्सल गुरिल्ला कंमाडर पहली बार कैमरे पर क्यों आया | Why Bhaskar Came on Camera After 30 Years
metadata.description:
After spending 30 years underground, senior CPI (Maoist) leader Bhaskar finally decided to surrender and return to the mainstream. In his last days as an armed rebel, Bhaskar spoke exclusively to Main Bhi Bharat contributor Ankur Tiwari at an undisclosed location — just two days before he laid down his weapons along with 50 other cadres.
In this rare on-camera interview, Bhaskar opens up about his decades-long life in the jungles, the ideology that drove him, and the disillusionment that made him choose peace over violence. While a large faction within the Maoist ranks still refuses to give up the gun, Bhaskar’s decision marks a turning point in the story of the insurgency in central India.
